{{Top|leg}}
The '''Af'El lion''' was a species of predator native to [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]]. Six Af'El lions were part of [[Cairn's Flying Circus]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] unit posing as a troupe of performers that toured the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] in an effort to locate the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] captured Rebel leader, [[Drun Cairnwick/Legends|Drun Cairnwick]].
